title: NotepadNext Plugin Manager: resource registration and lifecycle draft

screens.purpose: Installed plugin list, enabled and waiting for first command
Open through Plugins menu or toolbar icon
Edit Markdown with a live preview in the right dock

lifecycle.defaultUninstallDataPolicy: Keep settings and data; separately opt in to delete them.
lifecycle.enablePolicy: Restore commands immediately; start process on first command.
lifecycle.updatePolicy: Preserve enablement and inactive state. For running plugins, validate and activate before committing; restore previous version if activation fails.
lifecycle.securityCopy: Host API grants do not sandbox the OS permissions of local Node code.

iconPolicy.manager: Generic puzzle icon; no plugin-specific branding in Plugin Manager headings.
iconPolicy.verification: All 32 manager headers use the generic icon; 97 Markdown plugin icon instances remain. Uninstalled screen reviewed at 1200x760.
iconPolicy.plugin: Keep each plugin's own icon in its list entry, detail identity, contributed command and plugin window.

prototypeScope: Clickable main routes: check/register marketplace → Uninstalled; register single plugin → the same Uninstalled view with one resource; explicit Install → existing install review; remove registered source → empty resource state. Search, refresh, preexisting Installed examples and all shared-source combinations remain illustrative. Existing installed-plugin lifecycle flows remain available.

verification.visualReview: Full lifecycle board and close-up review passed; progress and replaced original manager rechecked after changes.

exampleData: Repository URL, author, plugins, versions and logs are illustrative; no plugin was installed.
runtimeChecks: Native Qt implementation, keyboard navigation and minimum-window behavior are outside this design draft.

resourceRegistration.registrationPolicy: All repository types register resources first and open Uninstalled. Registration downloads only bounded metadata, never plugin packages, and does not install or activate plugins. Only an explicit Install action enters package installation.

metadata.marketplaceValue: array of the same plugin metadata with list=false

views: Uninstalled: registered resources with no installed package
Sources: registered direct or marketplace repositories
resourceRegistration.uninstallPolicy: Return to Uninstalled when a registered resource source still exists.
resourceRegistration.removeSourcePolicy: Remove source associations and unavailable uninstalled resources; preserve installed packages, data and independent release origins.

verification.visualReview: Full resource-registration board and direct-plugin Uninstalled branch passed.

resourceRegistration.prototypeScope: Clickable main routes: check/register marketplace → Uninstalled; register single plugin → the same Uninstalled view with one resource; explicit Install → existing install review; remove registered source → empty resource state.
